"
     * Encodes an input string into an output phonetic representation, given a set of possible origin languages.
     *
     * @param input
     *            String to phoneticise; a String with dashes or spaces separating each word
     * @param languageSet
     * @return a phonetic representation of the input; a String containing '-'-separated phonetic representations
     *   of the input
     "

The `encode` method in the `PhoneticEngine` class encodes an input string into an output phonetic representation based on a set of possible origin languages. The method takes a string to phoneticize (with dashes or spaces separating each word) and a `Languages.LanguageSet` parameter, returning a phonetic representation of the input as a string containing '-'-separated phonetic representations.

Since the failing test is related to Beider Morse Phonetic Matching producing incorrect tokens, we should focus on how the `encode` method processes the input string and generates phonetic representations. The issue may lie in how the Beider Morse algorithm is implemented within this method, leading to unexpected token generation.
